title: Man fatally shot by Sûreté du Québec officer in Ste-Adèle
article: Quebec's independent investigations office (BEI) has opened an inquiry into the fatal shooting Thursday night by the Sûreté du Québec of a man in Ste-Adèle in the Laurentians.
According to information provided to the BEI by the SQ, police were called to a chalet on Lesage St. at 9:45 p.m. after a security alarm was set off.
Once at the scene, officers tried unsuccessfully to communicate with a 44-year-old man they found inside the building.
Police said the man reached into a backpack, and officers tried to subdue him with an electric stun gun.
Police told the BEI that the man then pulled a firearm from the backpack, at which point one of the officers opened fire, striking the man at least once.
The man was later declared dead in hospital.

The BEI, which is called in whenever a death or serious injury occurs during a police operation in Quebec, has assigned five investigators to the case and will be receiving technical support from the Montreal police department.
